reading: Recent abuse stories in entertainment reflect the consequences of changes that began years ago, rather than a sudden cultural change.
The television programme Married at First Sight UK has been cancelled following allegations of rape.
The men accused of rape and sexual misconduct on the programme deny all the allegations.
The recent stories began with journalistic investigations that started years ago.
Investigations usually take a long time because journalists gather evidence, check information and ask people to respond.
According to broadcaster Kirsty Wark, seeing other women come forward has given more women the courage to share their experiences.
In the past, women feared retaliation, meaning harmful action against them for reporting abuse.
Unions say junior freelance workers, who often have an uncertain income, still find it difficult to report problems.
Even well-known people may fear that raising concerns will cost them work, comedian Lucy Beaumont said.
Social media has also helped encourage people to report their experiences.
Harriet Wistrich from the Centre for Women's Justice says wealthy or famous people often use legal measures to discourage reporting.
There is growing recognition that leaders of media organisations have a responsibility to address abuse, rather than leaving victims to act alone.
Philippa Childs says the creative industries' current internal reporting systems are inadequate, meaning they do not work well enough.

vocabulary.definition: Results of earlier actions, events or changes.
Claims that someone has done something wrong, which still need to be proved.
Careful efforts to discover the facts about a situation.
Information or material that helps show whether something is true.
Offer information about an experience, especially something harmful or difficult.
Action intended to harm someone because they have complained or reported a problem.
People who take separate jobs or projects instead of having a permanent job with one employer.
A duty to take action or make sure something is handled properly.
Not good enough for what is needed.

entries.ja: それ以前の行動、出来事、変化によって生じた結果。
entries.ko: 이전의 행동, 사건 또는 변화로 인해 생긴 결과.
entries.zh-Hans: 先前的行为、事件或变化所带来的结果。
entries.es: Resultados de acciones, acontecimientos o cambios anteriores.
entries.pt-BR: Resultados de ações, acontecimentos ou mudanças anteriores.
entries.fr: Résultats d’actions, d’événements ou de changements antérieurs.
entries.de: Ergebnisse früherer Handlungen, Ereignisse oder Veränderungen.

entries.ja: 誰かが不正なことをしたという、まだ証明する必要がある主張。
entries.ko: 누군가가 잘못된 일을 했다는 주장으로, 아직 입증이 필요한 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 声称某人做了错事、但仍需证实的说法。
entries.es: Afirmaciones de que alguien ha hecho algo malo y que aún deben demostrarse.
entries.pt-BR: Afirmações de que alguém fez algo errado e que ainda precisam ser comprovadas.
entries.fr: Affirmations selon lesquelles une personne a fait quelque chose de mal et qui doivent encore être prouvées.
entries.de: Behauptungen, dass jemand etwas Unrechtes getan hat, die noch bewiesen werden müssen.

entries.ja: ある状況について事実を明らかにするために、注意深く調べること。
entries.ko: 어떤 상황에 관한 사실을 알아내기 위해 주의 깊게 조사하는 활동.
entries.zh-Hans: 为查明某种情况的事实而进行的细致调查。
entries.es: Esfuerzos minuciosos para descubrir los hechos sobre una situación.
entries.pt-BR: Esforços cuidadosos para descobrir os fatos sobre uma situação.
entries.fr: Démarches menées avec soin pour découvrir les faits concernant une situation.
entries.de: Sorgfältige Bemühungen, die Tatsachen zu einer Situation herauszufinden.

entries.ja: 何かが真実かどうかを示す助けとなる情報や資料。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 사실인지 판단하는 데 도움이 되는 정보나 자료.
entries.zh-Hans: 有助于判断某事是否属实的信息或材料。
entries.es: Información o material que ayuda a determinar si algo es verdad.
entries.pt-BR: Informações ou materiais que ajudam a mostrar se algo é verdadeiro.
entries.fr: Informations ou éléments matériels qui aident à déterminer si quelque chose est vrai.
entries.de: Informationen oder Materialien, die dabei helfen festzustellen, ob etwas wahr ist.

entries.ja: ある経験、特につらい経験や被害を受けた経験について、自ら情報を伝えること。
entries.ko: 어떤 경험, 특히 피해를 입었거나 힘들었던 경험에 관한 정보를 자발적으로 알리는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 主动提供有关某段经历的信息，尤其是受到伤害或遭遇困难的经历。
entries.es: Ofrecer información sobre una experiencia, especialmente una que haya causado daño o haya sido difícil.
entries.pt-BR: Oferecer informações sobre uma experiência, especialmente uma que tenha causado sofrimento ou tenha sido difícil.
entries.fr: Fournir volontairement des informations sur une expérience, en particulier une expérience douloureuse ou difficile.
entries.de: Von sich aus Informationen über ein Erlebnis geben, besonders über eines, bei dem jemand Schaden erlitten hat oder das schwierig war.

entries.ja: 苦情を述べたり問題を報告したりした人に、そのことを理由に害を与えようとする行為。
entries.ko: 누군가가 불만을 제기하거나 문제를 신고했다는 이유로 그 사람에게 해를 끼치려는 행동.
entries.zh-Hans: 因某人提出投诉或报告问题而意图伤害对方的行为。
entries.es: Acción destinada a perjudicar a alguien porque se ha quejado o ha informado de un problema.
entries.pt-BR: Ação destinada a prejudicar alguém por ter feito uma reclamação ou relatado um problema.
entries.fr: Action visant à nuire à une personne parce qu’elle s’est plainte ou a signalé un problème.
entries.de: Eine Handlung, die jemandem schaden soll, weil diese Person sich beschwert oder ein Problem gemeldet hat.

entries.ja: 一つの雇用主のもとで定職に就くのではなく、個別の仕事や案件を請け負う人たち。
entries.ko: 한 고용주 밑에서 고정적으로 일하는 대신 개별 일이나 프로젝트를 맡아 일하는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 不固定受雇于某一个雇主，而是承接单独的工作或项目的人。
entries.es: Personas que aceptan trabajos o proyectos por separado en lugar de tener un empleo permanente con un solo empleador.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que aceitam trabalhos ou projetos separados em vez de ter um emprego fixo com um único empregador.
entries.fr: Personnes qui acceptent des missions ou des projets distincts au lieu d’occuper un emploi permanent auprès d’un seul employeur.
entries.de: Menschen, die einzelne Aufträge oder Projekte übernehmen, statt bei einem einzigen Arbeitgeber fest angestellt zu sein.

entries.ja: 行動を起こしたり、物事が適切に処理されるようにしたりする義務。
entries.ko: 행동을 취하거나 어떤 일이 적절하게 처리되도록 해야 하는 의무.
entries.zh-Hans: 采取行动或确保某事得到妥善处理的义务。
entries.es: Deber de actuar o de asegurarse de que algo se gestione adecuadamente.
entries.pt-BR: Dever de agir ou de garantir que algo seja tratado de maneira adequada.
entries.fr: Devoir d’agir ou de veiller à ce qu’une chose soit traitée correctement.
entries.de: Die Pflicht, zu handeln oder dafür zu sorgen, dass etwas angemessen geregelt wird.

entries.ja: 求められることに対応するには不十分であること。
entries.ko: 필요한 수준을 충족할 만큼 충분히 좋지 않은 것.
entries.es: Que no es lo suficientemente bueno para lo que se necesita.
entries.pt-BR: Que não é bom o suficiente para atender ao que é necessário.
entries.fr: Qui n’est pas assez satisfaisant pour répondre aux besoins.
entries.de: Für die jeweiligen Anforderungen nicht gut genug.
